text: なかには　＊が　きろくされていた！

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: される is する turned around, so the thing is on the receiving end of the action. With ていた it was already in that state. きろくされていた = 'had been recorded'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた says something had happened and was still that way at the time. きろくされていた = 'was there, recorded'.
